speaker: Iqbal Mohamed
heading: Gaza: Humanitarian Situation
claim: Israel has used the Lavender AI system to target and kill thousands of Palestinians, including women and children.
quote: Israel has used Lavender AI systems to target and execute thousands of Palestinian children, women and men
source_name: 'Lavender': The AI machine directing Israel's bombing spree in Gaza
source_notes: No source named in speech; the +972 investigation is the original public account of Lavender.
incident_accuracy_note: Reporting says Lavender marked up to 37,000 suspected militants as targets with heavy civilian casualties permitted; the IDF denies it generates confirmed targets, so 'target and execute thousands' by Lavender is alleged rather than established.
vintage_rationale: Incident claim; first made public by +972 Magazine on 3 April 2024.

heading: Gaza: Humanitarian Situation

vintage_rationale: Talks reported days before the debate; no signed contract reported.

heading: Autumn Budget 2026 - Motion to Take Note
